# NeuroUI

> React component library with built-in cognitive accessibility.

NeuroUI provides React components that are beautiful by default and automatically adapt to users' sensory preferences (motion sensitivity, information density, focus needs, reading preferences, color vision, input method).

## Installation

npm install @neuroui/core @neuroui/components

## Quick Start

Wrap your app with NeuroProvider. All NeuroUI components will automatically adapt to the user's OS accessibility settings.

import { NeuroProvider } from '@neuroui/core';
import { Button, Dialog, Input, Card, ToastProvider, Toaster, useToast } from '@neuroui/components';

<NeuroProvider>
  <ToastProvider>
    <App />
    <Toaster />
  </ToastProvider>
</NeuroProvider>

## Components (15 total)

### Button
<Button variant="primary" size="md">Click me</Button>
Variants: primary, secondary, outline, ghost, danger
Sizes: sm, md, lg
Props: variant, size, loading, icon, className, and all HTML button attributes.
Danger variant uses --neuro-color-error CSS variable for CVD-safe color.

### Toast
const { toast } = useToast();
toast({ title: 'Saved', variant: 'success' });
Variants: info, success, warning, error
Wrap your app with <ToastProvider> and render <Toaster /> to display toasts.
Border colors use --neuro-color-* CSS variables for CVD-safe colors.

### Dialog
<Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} title="Confirm">
  <p>Are you sure?</p>
  <Dialog.Actions>
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleConfirm}>Confirm</Button>
  </Dialog.Actions>
</Dialog>
Props: open, onOpenChange, title, description, closable, size, children.

### Input
<Input label="Email" type="email" hint="We won't share this" />
Note: label prop is required for accessibility.
Props: label, hint, error, success, icon, and all HTML input attributes.
Error/success colors use CSS variables for CVD safety.

### Card
<Card variant="elevated" interactive>
  <Card.Header>Title</Card.Header>
  <Card.Body>Content</Card.Body>
  <Card.Footer>Footer</Card.Footer>
</Card>
Variants: default, outlined, elevated
Sub-components: Card.Header, Card.Body, Card.Footer

### Select
<Select label="Country" options={[{ value: 'us', label: 'United States' }]} />
Props: label, hint, error, options, placeholder, icon.
Note: label prop is required for accessibility.

### Checkbox
<Checkbox label="I agree to terms" />
Props: label, error, indeterminate.
44px click area includes label. Checkmark icon (never color-only).

### Radio / RadioGroup
<RadioGroup name="color" label="Favorite color" value={value} onChange={setValue}>
  <Radio label="Red" value="red" />
  <Radio label="Blue" value="blue" />
</RadioGroup>
Props (RadioGroup): name, value, onChange, label, error, orientation.
Props (Radio): label, value.

### Tabs
<Tabs defaultValue="tab1">
  <TabList><Tab value="tab1">Tab 1</Tab><Tab value="tab2">Tab 2</Tab></TabList>
  <TabPanel value="tab1">Content 1</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel value="tab2">Content 2</TabPanel>
</Tabs>
Arrow key navigation. Active tab: underline + background (not color alone).

### Accordion
<Accordion type="single">
  <AccordionItem value="item1">
    <AccordionTrigger value="item1">Section 1</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent value="item1">Content</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
Props: type ('single' | 'multiple'), defaultValue. density:minimal forces single.

### Alert
<Alert variant="warning" title="Disk space low">You have less than 1GB remaining.</Alert>
Variants: info, success, warning, error
Props: variant, title, children, closable, onClose, icon.
Uses --neuro-color-* for CVD-safe accent colors.

### Badge
<Badge variant="success">Active</Badge>
Variants: default, info, success, warning, error
Semantic variants include default dot icons. CVD-safe via CSS variables.

### Tooltip
<Tooltip content="More info"><Button>Hover me</Button></Tooltip>
Props: content, position (top/bottom/left/right), children.
Triggers on hover + focus (never hover-only). density:minimal disables tooltips.

### Navigation
<Navigation label="Main" orientation="horizontal">
  <Navigation.Item href="/" active>Home</Navigation.Item>
  <Navigation.Item href="/about">About</Navigation.Item>
</Navigation>
Active item: background + border (not color alone). Arrow key navigation.

### Table
<Table striped stickyHeader>
  <Table.Header><Table.Row><Table.Head sortable>Name</Table.Head></Table.Row></Table.Header>
  <Table.Body><Table.Row><Table.Cell>John</Table.Cell></Table.Row></Table.Body>
</Table>
Sub-components: Table.Header, Table.Body, Table.Row, Table.Head, Table.Cell.
Table.Head props: sortable, sortDirection, onSort.

## Sensory Profile (11 dimensions)

NeuroProvider auto-detects OS settings (prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-contrast, pointer: coarse, forced-colors). Components adapt automatically. Override with:

<NeuroProvider profile={{ motion: 'none', density: 'minimal', colorVision: 'deuteranopia' }}>

Profile fields:
- motion: 'none' | 'reduced' | 'full'
- contrast: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high'
- density: 'minimal' | 'normal' | 'detailed'
- notifications: 'silent' | 'visual' | 'audio' | 'all'
- font: 'default' | 'dyslexia-friendly' | 'monospace'
- spacing: 'compact' | 'normal' | 'relaxed'
- focus: 'standard' | 'enhanced'
- timing: 'patient' | 'normal' | 'quick'
- flashSafety: boolean (true = suppress all flashing/blinking per WCAG 2.3.1)
- colorVision: 'typical' | 'protanopia' | 'deuteranopia' | 'tritanopia' | 'achromatopsia'
- inputMethod: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' | 'touch' | 'switch' | 'voice'

## Presets (5)

<NeuroProvider preset="calm">      — no motion, relaxed spacing, patient timing, minimal density, visual notifications, enhanced focus
<NeuroProvider preset="focus">     — enhanced focus indicators, minimal density, reduced motion
<NeuroProvider preset="safe">      — flash safety on, reduced motion, enhanced focus
<NeuroProvider preset="colorSafe"> — deuteranopia palette, high contrast, enhanced focus

## Hooks (8)

const { profile, setProfile, resetProfile } = useNeuro();
const { motionLevel, isMotionSafe } = useMotionSafety();
const { density, isDenseLayout } = useCognitiveLoad();
const { fontFamily, lineHeight, letterSpacing } = useReadability();
const { isFocusMode, toggleFocusMode } = useFocusMode();
const { isFlashSafe } = useFlashSafety();
const { colorVision, needsColorRedundancy } = useColorVision();
const { inputMethod, needsLargerTargets, needsVisibleLabels } = useInputMethod();

## Tailwind Plugin

npm install -D @neuroui/tailwind

import neuroPlugin from '@neuroui/tailwind';
// Add to plugins array in tailwind.config

Variants (20 total):
- Motion: neuro-motion-none, neuro-motion-reduced, neuro-motion-full
- Density: neuro-minimal, neuro-detailed
- Spacing: neuro-relaxed, neuro-compact
- Focus: neuro-focus-enhanced
- Timing: neuro-patient
- Contrast: neuro-high-contrast
- Flash safety: neuro-flash-safe
- Input method: neuro-touch, neuro-keyboard, neuro-switch, neuro-voice
- Color vision: neuro-cvd, neuro-protanopia, neuro-deuteranopia, neuro-tritanopia, neuro-achromatopsia

## Key Rules for AI Code Generation

1. Always wrap app root with <NeuroProvider>.
2. Always provide a label prop for Input, Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup.
3. Prefer semantic variants (variant="danger" not custom red styling).
4. Do not add custom motion/animation CSS. Components handle motion based on user preferences.
5. Use className for additional Tailwind styling.
6. Wrap with <ToastProvider> and add <Toaster /> when using toasts.
7. Never use color as the sole indicator. All components use icon + text + border for semantic states.
8. Use --neuro-color-* CSS variables for semantic colors (not hardcoded hex values).
9. Use --neuro-min-target-size for touch target sizes.
